title: The build pipeline is free functions over the text, not builder methods
body:
`SuffixArrayBuilder` (`libsufr/src/build.rs`, 1335 lines) holds the configuration setters and, as `&self` methods, the whole construction pipeline: `normalize_text`, `partition` (121 lines), `sort_partitions`, `sort_partition`, `merge_sort`, `merge` (138 lines), `write_partitions`, `find_lcp`, `find_n_run` and `header`. Each pipeline method reads one to four builder fields; the pair `seed_mask` and `max_query_len` is read by every comparison, `partition` reads `is_dna`, `allow_ambiguity` and `n_ranges`, and `write_partitions` reads `text`. The file also holds the `ScratchBuffer` trait with its disk and memory impls, the `PartitioningAlphabet` trait with three impls, and `Partition`, `PartitionedSuffixes` and `Arrays`.

## Proposal

The builder keeps the constructors, the `with_` setters and `build_to_file`, and nothing else. `build_to_file` reads as a pipeline of named steps, each a free function taking the text as `&[u8]` plus the few values it uses, with the suffix arrays as `&mut [T]` or scratch buffers.

- `build/partition.rs`: `partition(text, alphabet, keep, mask)` and an `Alphabet { table, count }` struct replacing the trait and its three impls.
- `build/sort.rs`: `sort_partition`, `merge_sort` and `merge`, each taking `text`, `mask: Option<&SeedMask>` and `max_query_len: usize` as separate parameters.
- `build/scratch.rs`: `ScratchBuffer` and its two impls, unchanged.
- `build/write.rs`: `write(path, header, text, partitions)`.
- `is_dna` and `allow_ambiguity` become one `[bool; 256]` table of first bytes that start a kept suffix, computed once in `build_to_file`.

`mask` and `max_query_len` stay two parameters rather than one value. The `.sufr` bytes do not change; the create benchmark on the 50 MB input runs before and after.

## Out of scope

The entry point `SuffixArray::build` and the builder's public constructors: sufr-f5d441.
